org_research:
350 Bay Area Action — 2026 Candidate Survey, Alameda County city races. Transcribed verbatim from the live form.

DUE AUGUST 27, 2026. Estimated 30 minutes. Submitted through a Google account; a copy is emailed on submission and the form warns to confirm that copy arrives. Files and a candidate photo may be uploaded or emailed to electoral-endorsements@350bayareaaction.org

THE ORGANISATION ASKS THAT AI NOT BE USED. Verbatim: "Because it's important we get to know your positions and thinking, we request no use of AI in answering questions." That request is recorded here so it travels with the questionnaire. Drafting assistance should not be used on this one; fact-checking a claim the candidate has already written is a separate matter and the candidate's call.

FORM SHAPE. Two rating grids are split here into one item per row — six land use and budget items, four environmental protection and equity items — each rated on the same four-point scale, so they can be answered and tracked individually. The data centre question is check-all-that-apply and its options are kept in the question text.

Research not attached.
